question.knowledge_point: Finding the Equation of a Circle Given a Graph
question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13956996/assets/b5a933346a903b6712b3df53fa2f241b070ef80146078b96b8f4360ae6650233.png)

What is the equation of the circle given above?
question.worked_solution:
The general equation of a circle with radius $r$ centered at the origin is 

$$
{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}={r}^{2}.
$$

From the picture, we see that our circle is centered at $(0,0)$ and has radius $r=3.$ So, the equation is

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & ={r}^{2} \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & ={3}^{2} \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & =9.\end{aligned}
$$
